findings.summary: Open question 1 misstates current contact behavior — the live form already does a mailto: handoff to hello@luisexpert.dev in addition to the local thanks acknowledgment, so option (b) is the status quo, not a change.
findings.fix: Correct the premise to describe both behaviors (local ack + mailto:hello@luisexpert.dev redirect, src/index.html:1813-1815) and restate the options as (a) drop the mailto handoff and keep client-only acknowledgment, (b) keep the current mailto: handoff (name the destination address so FR5/FR6 can pin it), (c) integrate a real submission endpoint — otherwise the gate may keep client-only and unintentionally regress the mailto behavior users have today.

findings.summary: @S16 and @S12 (contact.feature:41) use Given a portfolio build where content empty / LinkedIn URL invalid but no requirement or assumption states content or the LinkedIn URL is data/config-driven, so the tester cannot produce such a build without editing product source.
findings.fix: Add an explicit assumption or FR that section content and social URLs are data/config-driven (e.g. a content data module) so empty/invalid build variants are constructible, or reword both Givens to a reachable form (e.g. Given the content source has an empty About section, when the site is built from it...).
